name: Adobe Premiere
description: Video editing in Adobe Premiere (called Premiere Pro before version 26): projects, cutting, text, audio levels and export.
appVersionTested: Premiere Pro 25.x and Premiere 26.x on Windows, checked against Adobe help pages and shortcut lists
notes: Version 26 renamed the app from Premiere Pro to Premiere; the executable kept its old name at launch, so both are matched. Text styling moved from Essential Graphics to the Properties panel in 25.0. UIA quality is an estimate: menus and dialogs are exposed, panels and the timeline are custom drawn. Regions assume the default Editing workspace at 1920 by 1080.
